podcast.title: Influence on Dan Auerbach
podcast.body: Junior Kimbrough, a blues singer, significantly influenced Dan Auerbach in high school. His music was a pivotal inspiration that led Auerbach to dedicate himself to playing the guitar full-time, ultimately leading to The Black Keys' tribute album, *Chulahoma*. "Dan was a big fan of this guy in high school. In fact, listening to Kimbrough, while smoking a lot of dope, helped him decide to pursue the guitar full time."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Catching Up With The Black Keys

xref.title: Junior Kimbrough's Influence on Dan Auerbach
xref.body: Junior Kimbrough, a blues singer and the subject of The Black Keys' *Chulahoma* EP, was a profound influence on Dan Auerbach. Dan was a devoted fan in high school, and listening to Kimbrough, particularly while smoking marijuana, proved to be a pivotal experience that guided his decision to pursue a full-time career as a guitarist. "In fact, listening to Kimbrough, while smoking a lot of dope, helped him decide to pursue the guitar full time."
